title.zh: Nature Communications：破解手写脑机接口的多维密码
title.en: Nature Communications: cracking the multidimensional code of handwriting BCI

summary.zh: 首次系统揭示运动皮层对手写运动的多维编码机制（三维笔尖轨迹、握力、笔压），为意念书写装上“立体眼睛”。博士生王泽滨为第一作者，郝耀耀、王跃明为共同通讯。
summary.en: First systematic account of multidimensional motor-cortical coding of handwriting (3D trajectory, grip force, pen pressure). First author: Zebin Wang; co-corresponding: Yaoyao Hao & Yueming Wang.

source: 知乎（作者投稿）/ 新浪财经

title.zh: 课题组侵入式 BCI 工作获国际 BCI Award 提名（12 强）
title.en: Team's invasive BCI work nominated for the International BCI Award (top 12)

summary.zh: “脑写汉字”成果（徐广祥、王泽滨等）入选 2025 国际 BCI 研究奖 12 强提名，颁奖礼于维也纳 IEEE SMC 2025 举行。
summary.en: The brain-writing work (Guangxiang Xu, Zebin Wang, et al.) was named among the 12 nominees of the 2025 International BCI Research Award; ceremony at IEEE SMC 2025, Vienna.

title.zh: “硬币大小”全植入脑机接口获类脑智能大赛一等奖
title.en: Coin-sized fully implantable BCI wins first prize at brain-inspired intelligence contest

summary.zh: 无线供电、可全天工作的全植入式脑机接口微系统获“创客天下·杭向未来”类脑智能专项赛一等奖（潮新闻报道）。
summary.en: The wirelessly powered, always-on fully implantable BCI microsystem won first prize at the 2025 Brain-Inspired Intelligence (BCI) Contest in Hangzhou.

title.zh: “脑写汉字”：1000 常用字库最高识别率 91.1%

summary.zh: 郝耀耀研究员、王跃明教授为通讯作者的汉字书写脑机接口工作发表于 Advanced Science，第一作者为生物医学工程博士生徐广祥。
summary.en: The Chinese handwriting BCI work was published in Advanced Science; first author: BME Ph.D. student Guangxiang Xu; corresponding: Yaoyao Hao & Yueming Wang.

title.zh: 央视报道：用意念操控机械手写下“浙江大学”“脑机接口”
title.en: CCTV: writing "Zhejiang University" and "BCI" with thought-controlled robotic hand

summary.zh: 志愿者张大伯——我国首例侵入式脑机接口临床志愿者——已能用意念操控机械手书写汉字。
summary.en: Volunteer "Uncle Zhang", China's first invasive BCI clinical volunteer, writes Chinese characters with thought.

title.zh: 浙江大学首次实现汉字书写脑机接口，“意念写字”成现实
title.en: ZJU realizes Chinese handwriting BCI — "thought writing" becomes reality

summary.zh: 高位截瘫志愿者用意念在脑海中书写，机械臂一笔一画写出“浙江大学脑机接口”八个字；100 常用汉字离线分类正确率 91.3%。
summary.en: A paralyzed volunteer imagined writing while a robotic arm wrote the characters; 91.3% offline accuracy on 100 common characters.

title.zh: 国内首例植入式脑机接口临床转化研究取得阶段性成果
title.en: First-in-China invasive BCI clinical translation reaches milestone

summary.zh: 高位截瘫患者通过植入式脑机接口用意念控制机械手，完成握手、喝水等动作。
summary.en: A paralyzed patient controlled a robotic hand to shake hands and drink via an invasive BCI.
